data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word ‘tov’, meaning ‘good’ or ‘graceful’. Toviana was a name given to the beautiful and graceful daughters of the Israelites. The name Toviana carries the meaning “Graceful, beautiful, pleasing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Toviana usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies God's blessings and favor.
data.etymology: Toviana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, beautiful, pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Toviana total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Daughters with the name Toviana were celebrated for their physical and moral beauty, as they represented the best of femininity in their society. The name continues to be popular within Christian communities, reminding us of the goodness and grace of God and the importance of cultivating these qualities in our lives.

The name Toviana is a reflection of God's grace and mercy in our lives, inspiring us to strive for spiritual growth, excellence, and purity in all aspects of life. data.spiritual_symbolism: Toviana is a name derived from the Hebrew word "tov" meaning good or gracious. It symbolizes the grace and goodness of God in the life of the bearer, encouraging them to embody these qualities and radiate His love.

This Theodora was a wealthy noblewoman who converted to Christianity during the reign of Emperor Honorius (395-423 AD). Toviana is said to have accompanied Theodora to a place of execution, where they both died as martyrs.
